_meta.semantics: Apply each pair by replacing `before` with `after` in post_content. `before` is a literal substring, verified unique (or `occurrences` times) in the stored content at generation time. Nothing else in the document changes.
_meta.mt_note: DE pages are auto-translated from EN on EN save. For MT-managed twins, apply EN first, read what the pipeline produced, and only write the DE pair if the pipeline leaves a banned word or breaks meaning. The DE strings here are the review reference.

notes.792: Commercial Storage (EN). Single rail stage title, same defect 6921 had in German.

notes.749: Residential Storage (EN). Rail title twice plus 'shipping date'; 'shipping' here means delivery, so 'delivery date' is the accurate word, not a euphemism.
notes.2748: Services & Support (EN). These two were missed by the #905 table because that pass read the rendered page and these live in a comparison card; the strings are unchanged since. No DE twin action here.
notes.3302: Solution Configurator (EN). One sentence, 'before ordering' → 'before the inquiry' per the established mapping.
notes.1755: Utility-Scale Storage (EN). 'a shipping schedule confirmed in the order' → 'a delivery schedule confirmed in the Proforma': both the shipping noun and the order noun were wrong. notes.6917: Großspeicher: DE twin of 1755. 'im Auftrag bestätigten Versandplan' → 'in der Proformarechnung bestätigten Lieferplan'; 'Auftrag' is the order document that does not exist.
notes.6873: Danke (DE thank-you page). Both hits are in the 'what to check before you buy' guidance, which is about the inquiry step, not a checkout.
notes.623: Thank You (EN). Mirror of 6873 plus 'Technical articles' → 'Technical posts'.
notes.552: Checklist post (EN). The hit is a body sentence, not the technical power-up sequence — the sequence words are fine.

notes.6698: DE twin of 1038. Same two fixes: 'Auftragsbestätigung' -> 'Lieferdokumente' (the site issues no order confirmation in either language) and 'Bestellnummer' -> 'Proformanummer' three times.
